description_en: Updates a custom check item in the Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) custom check item feature
description_zh: 在云安全态势管理自定义检查项功能中，更新用户自定义检查项
name: UpdateCheckItem

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the sections associated with the check item
parameters.help_zh: 检查项关联的章节ID数组
parameters.name: section_ids

parameters.help_en:
The cloud asset vendor.
You can call the [ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~) operation to obtain the available vendors
parameters.help_zh:
云资产厂商。
您可调用[ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~)接口获取可填入的厂商
parameters.name: vendor

parameters.help_en:
The asset type of the cloud service.
You can call the [ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的资产类型。
您可调用[ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The asset subtype of the cloud service.
You can call the [ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的资产子类型。
您可调用[ListCloudAssetSchemas](~~ListCloudAssetSchemas~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_sub_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom check item
parameters.name: check_show_name

parameters.help_en:
The risk level of the check item. Valid values:
HIGH: High.
MEDIUM: Medium.
LOW: Low
parameters.help_zh:
检查项的风险等级。取值：
HIGH：高危
MEDIUM：中危
LOW：低危
parameters.name: risk_level

parameters.help_en:
The status of the check item. Valid values:
EDIT: Being edited.
RELEASE: Published.

Changing the status from Published to Being edited purges all historical records.
Only check items in the Published status can be used for checks
parameters.help_zh:
检查项状态。取值：
EDIT：编辑中
RELEASE：已发布

从已发布改为编辑中会清除所有历史记录
只有已发布状态才能使用检查项检查
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en:
The type of the check item description. Valid values:

text: Text
fields.help_zh:
检查项描述信息类型。取值：

text：文本
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The description of the check item
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The description of the check item
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en:
The type of the help information for the check item risk. Valid values:

text: Text
fields.help_zh:
检查项风险的帮助信息类型。取值：

text：文本
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The content of the help information for the check item risk
fields.help_zh: 检查项风险的帮助信息的内容
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The help information for the check item
parameters.name: assist_info

fields.help_en:
The type of the solution information for the check item. Valid values:

text: Text
fields.help_zh:
检查项解决方案信息类型。取值：

text：文本
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The solution content for the check item risk
fields.help_zh: 检查项风险的解决方案内容
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The solution information for the check item
parameters.name: solution

parameters.help_en: The definition rule of the custom check item
parameters.help_zh: 自定义检查项定义规则
parameters.name: check_rule

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the custom check item to update.
You can call the [ListCheckItems](~~ListCheckItems~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
待更新的自定义检查项ID。
您可调用[ListCheckItems](~~ListCheckItems~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: check_id

CheckId.description_en: The ID of the updated check item

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
